final_decision.rationale: Compression/blur ruled out by 0%FP signals (block_boundary=1.0017, unique_G=256, spectral_slope_ratio=0.9996). Generator allows one category per slot and a single global step, so the deterministic saturation cannot be the only step: peeling satYCrCb leaves structured residual. Saturation family: YCrCb strongly beats HSV (HSV ms off 0.15+, vr 78-92% off); severity 3 (c=5) gives the best cross-pair moment consistency (sat4 matched pair0 but vr 22% off pair2). Noise slot: poisson sev1 is the only type with verify_signals MATCH (4/4) on all 5 pairs. Noise steps are never LIKELY (seed mismatch); deterministic severity not PSNR-confirmed because sigma>2 -> overall UNCERTAIN.

contrast_spread_ratio=1.2643 lies in the 1.20–1.30 boundary band (raw contrast flag), but contrast_saturation_corrected=true; a pure contrast step keeps mean_shift≈0 (contradicts +0.063) and channel scaling gives chroma_ratio≈spread_ratio (observed 2.16 vs 1.26).
